description: This file defines an interface for a composition buffer used within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace. It specifies the structure, methods, and enumerations for managing frame buffers with hardware optimizations, including plane access, reference counting, and buffer metadata.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: Interface for managing composition buffers with methods for plane access, reference counting, rendering, and metadata.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: Represents a plane within the buffer, providing access to data accessor, stride, and offset.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing planes within the buffer.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the buffer.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the buffer.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the buffer's planes, with a timeout parameter.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Signals that the buffer has been processed, with a flag indicating if it's dirty.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for display scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format of the buffer.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the modifier indicating pixel arrangement for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DataType of the buffer (Invalid, DMA, Raw).
